thread:
Noah (People Ops): quick drop: tiny "one-card" goal-setting + feedback cheatsheets for engineers and managers. copy/paste friendly for 1:1s and PRs :card_index:
Priya (Eng Manager): can we get a short example for a measurable outcome and a one-line coaching nudge?
Noah (People Ops): sure. example outcome: "Outcome: Improve embed throughput by 30% for batch size 64; Metric: tokens/sec 1200 -> 1560; Owner: Liam; Quarter: Q3". Coaching nudge: "What's one small change that would move the needle on this metric?"
Liam (SWE): can you add a 2-line self-review blurb that fits in a changelog entry?
Noah (People Ops): done. Self-review blurb: "Outcome I owned: <one sentence>. Key evidence: <link(s) & metric delta>. Learning: <one sentence>."
Goals Bot: reminder  ensure managers request self-reviews 7 days before calibration (auto)
Priya (Eng Manager): include a short rubric for goal difficulty so teams calibrate stretch vs runway
Noah (People Ops): added micro-rubric: Conservative = maintain; Stretch = ~20%-50% harder; Moonshot = >50% and speculative
Liam (SWE): can we have a paste-ready manager checklist (3 bullets) and an IC micro-ask (2 bullets)? keeps 1:1s tight
Noah (People Ops): pasted below. ready to copy into threads or 1:1 agendas

--- paste-ready manager checklist ---
- Confirm scope & dependencies
- Agree on 1 measurable outcome + target
- Ask a coaching question (one-step-bigger)

--- paste-ready IC micro-self-review (2 lines) ---
- One-line outcome + metric
- Evidence links  learning / next-step

--- calibration quick signals ---
- Signal: metric variance >= 20% vs plan
- Evidence: links to dashboards, PRs, user feedback

Priya (Eng Manager): this is concise and shareable. i'll send to my team. thanks Noah :sparkles:
